name: qbr-renewal
description: Generate an owned-products QBR and prepare a source-backed renewal or discovery brief.

interface.shortDescription: Customer QBRs and clear renewal preparation
interface.longDescription: Create a QBR for the customer's owned products, save the verified deck locally, and prepare a concise CSM brief: value already realised, YoY and peer context, focus areas, product-linked next value moves, and discovery questions. Combines QBR evidence review, current Scaled CS recommendations, and selective release validation. One Terminal command installs all runtime and connection components; each colleague uses their own company sign-in.
defaultPrompt: Create a QBR for this customer using owned products only.
Prepare a QBR and one-page brief for this customer's renewal.
Prepare a renewal brief from this QBR without another deck.
